subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's private-transcript successful-terminal-turn predicate as the lifecycle recovery boundary for the lost-context/output mismatch?
rationale: The code appears technically sound, but it changes whether a stale active subagent run is reported as failed or successful, so maintainer intent is needed for the session-state and delivery semantics before merge.

options.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
options.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the branch follows the maintainer-stated current-run private transcript and explicit successful terminal-turn direction.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Race Proof
options.body: Ask for live Agent Teams or Gateway evidence if maintainers want proof beyond the transcript-reader boundary before accepting the lifecycle change.

options.title: Keep Error-Only Fallback
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers decide lost-context recovery must not infer success from private transcript terminal state.

recommendation.title: Accept Private Transcript Boundary
recommendation.body: Proceed after exact-head checks because the branch follows the maintainer-stated current-run private transcript and explicit successful terminal-turn direction.
